case_name.description: The case caption or case name for the pleading.

court.description: The court where the pleading was filed.

docket_number.description: The docket, case, or cause number shown on the pleading.

defendants.description: All named defendants in the pleading.

defendant_id.description: The stable defendant identifier if shown or inferable from the pleading.

aliases.description: Aliases, screen names, or handles associated with the defendant.

residence.description: Residence or location associated with the defendant.

role.description: The role attributed to the defendant in the alleged scheme.

counts.description: Every charged count in the pleading. Count ranges must be expanded into one item per count.

count_label.description: The count label exactly as used in the document, e.g. Count Twelve.

offense.description: The charged offense named for this count.

defendants.description: Defendant names charged in this count.

incorporated_paragraphs.description: Paragraphs incorporated by reference for this count.

date_range.description: Date range alleged for this count.

source_page.description: The generated PDF page where the count heading starts.

charged_facts.description: Every charged act, overt act, predicate act, or count-linked fact alleged in the pleading. Extract all items, including repeated or cross-referenced acts.

fact_id.description: The stable act identifier shown in the pleading.

paragraph_id.description: The paragraph identifier for the act.

primary_count.description: The primary count to which this act belongs.

also_applies_to_counts.description: Other counts to which this same act is expressly incorporated or cross-applied.

relationship_type.description: How the fact relates to the primary count. Allowed values: charged_act = The act is directly charged as part of the primary count.; incorporated_by_reference = The act is incorporated into another count by reference.; background_only = The act is background context and not directly charged.; null = The relationship type is not found.

date.description: The act date in ISO format.

actor.description: The main actor for this fact.

actor_alias.description: Alias or handle used by the actor in this fact.

defendants.description: Defendants expressly associated with the fact.

victim.description: Victim, rights holder, entity, or counterparty affected by the fact.

object.description: The work, file, product, account, payment, or other object involved.

venue.description: Server, channel, location, district, or venue tied to the act.

amount_usd.description: Dollar amount alleged for this fact, if any.

referenced_exhibits.description: Exhibits or schedules referenced for this fact.

source_page.description: The generated PDF page where the act starts.
